## `set_project_github`

*Available in [R](#set_project_github-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function allows you to set the Project's GitHub location.
    This will overwrite the current value if exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    set_project_github(git_url = "")

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `git_url` - A string containing the URL to the GitHub repository for this project.

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A message stating the name has been changed.
